memorial_details:
Name: Handley Page Halifax LW693
Type: Board / Plaque / Tablet
Description: A wall-mounted brass plaque.
Inscription: TO COMMEMORATE THE CREW OF/ THE HANDLEY PAGE HALIFAX BOMBER 'V' FOR VICTOR/ OF NO. 425 SQUADRON ROYAL CANADIAN AIR FORCE/ WHO DIED IN THE CRASH AT BRADFORD ON AVON, WILTSHIRE/ ON 26TH MARCH 1944/ [crew names inscribed on memorial]
Location: Westbury House Saint Margaret's Street, Bradford On Avon West Wiltshire Wiltshire BA15 1DE England
Grid Ref: ST 82557 60875
Coordinates: 51.346688865150,-2.251819804889
Photos: https://media.iwm.org.uk/ciim5/memorials/84/93/2_58.jpg; https://media.iwm.org.uk/ciim5/memorials/178/661/large_24276.jpg

Memorial Unveiling: The unveiling of the Handley Page Halifax LW693 memorial.
narrative: This memorial honors the crew of Handley Page Halifax bomber 'V', belonging to No. 425 Squadron of the Royal Canadian Air Force, who perished in a crash at Bradford on Avon, Wiltshire, on March 26, 1944.
inscription:
TO COMMEMORATE THE CREW OF
THE HANDLEY PAGE HALIFAX BOMBER 'V' FOR VICTOR
OF NO. 425 SQUADRON ROYAL CANADIAN AIR FORCE
